title: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: UE requested bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE requests modification of bearer resources and network accepts by initiating appropriate bearer procedures.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request modification of bearer resources.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer context for which resource modification is requested.

entities.name: Traffic flow aggregate IE
entities.description: Contains packet filter identifiers indicated by UE for bearer resource modification.

entities.name: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure
entities.description: Procedure to activate a dedicated EPS bearer context.

entities.name: EPS bearer context modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure to modify an existing EPS bearer context.

entities.name: EPS bearer context deactivation procedure
entities.description: Procedure to deactivate an EPS bearer context.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message initiating dedicated EPS bearer context activation.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message initiating EPS bearer context modification.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message initiating EPS bearer context deactivation.

entities.name: T3481
entities.description: Timer used during bearer resource modification procedure.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by UE after stopping timer T3481.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity (PTI)
entities.description: Identifies the procedure transaction between UE and network.

entities.name: TFT contains only uplink packet filters
entities.description: Condition where bearer resource modification results in TFT containing only uplink packet filters.

relations.description: Bearer resource modification procedure involves sending BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message.
BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message contains EPS bearer identity IE.
BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message contains Traffic flow aggregate IE.
Network may initiate dedicated EPS bearer activation procedure when bearer resource modification is accepted.
Network may initiate EPS bearer modification procedure when bearer resource modification is accepted.
Network may initiate EPS bearer deactivation procedure when bearer resource modification is accepted.
If TFT contains only uplink packet filters, network may initiate EPS bearer deactivation procedure.
Receipt of ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST stops timer T3481.
Receipt of MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST stops timer T3481.
Receipt of DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST stops timer T3481.
Receipt of ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST causes UE to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST contains procedure transaction identity.
ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST contains EPS bearer identity IE.
